column1: # SPEC-011 T021 — English function words and generic verbs excluded from the
# WHY THIS IS NOT A VIOLATION OF FR-006. Inspecting the toolkit's 2,001 promise
# "very", "person", "long" — function words and generic verbs that would make
# "I will be good" an astrology question. This is one small, generic, reviewable
# list of English words; it is not a per-topic taxonomy, and nobody has to touch
# it when the toolkit changes. FR-006 forbids maintaining the TAXONOMY by hand,
# and the taxonomy still comes entirely from the toolkit.
# Every word research.md §4 named is here, and removing one is a data decision
